subject.title: feat(system-agent): agentic cached caretaker greeting with quick actions

question: Should opening an idle system-agent chat automatically invoke the configured model to phrase a cached caretaker greeting when system facts change?
rationale: The branch adds a new user-visible inference and token-use mode rather than repairing an established behavior; the related umbrella proposal is still open and carries maintainer product-decision routing.

options.title: Sponsor the cached agentic greeting
options.body: Accept automatic greeting inference on a facts change, subject to delivery proof and the existing deterministic fallback guarantees.

options.title: Keep greetings deterministic
options.body: Retain the status chips and host-owned notices but do not make a model call merely because the custodian view opens.

options.title: Defer this phase
options.body: Keep the broader overhaul open until maintainers decide the desired identity, disclosure, and token-use policy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the cached agentic greeting
recommendation.body: Accept automatic greeting inference on a facts change, subject to delivery proof and the existing deterministic fallback guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature is explicitly presented as phase E of the umbrella system-agent proposal and the same contributor recently carried the adjacent session-ownership design.
